title: 第11章  前往赤霞县驻所
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
来往的镇魔卫纷纷驻足，整个院子瞬间安静下来。
陆渊嘴角勾起一抹漫不经心的冷笑。
再说一遍又如何？
第一次听到有人提出这种要求。
“我说，你算什么东西，也配来主持公道！听清了吗？不行我再说一遍。”
“陆渊！”
周通暴喝一声，整个人就像是一头被激怒的黑熊。
他可是在册七年的镇魔卫，杀过数百只妖魔，哪个新人不得客客气气喊他一声“周大人”？
可眼前这个刚入门的小子居然在大庭广众之下羞辱他！
周通一只手按在刀柄上，语气中透着森寒。
“我是真没想到，你竟然会蠢到这种地步。”
“你以为凭借一块直升腰牌就能加入镇魔司了？”
“实话告诉你，像你这种资质的新人，就算进入镇魔司也只是个杂役！”
“但我不一样，我是初境武者，更是在册七年的镇魔卫，你猜在这镇魔司之内，我跟你的份量孰轻孰重？”
周通眼神凶狠，直视陆渊，试图在那张俊逸的脸上看出几分自卑慌乱的情绪。
然而并没有。
陆渊眼神平静，双眸之中的漠然如同古井。
“三息。”
他拉开右臂，灵力如渊似海轰然爆发，瞬间化作一层灵晶覆盖在小臂之上。
“就三息，三息之后，你最好第一时间告诉我孰轻孰重。”

他一拳轰出，重重砸在对方腰腹之上。
沛然巨力爆发，周通面露痛苦，一口鲜血狂喷出去。
不过他毕竟是在册七年的镇魔卫，老练的战斗意识让他在第一时间便拔出了腰间横刀。
可他却没想到，陆渊的速度比他更快。
横刀还未出鞘，第二拳便已经轰出，如炮弹般砸在了他的脸上。
准确的说，是嘴上。
只听一声沉闷爆响，周通颌骨碎裂，嘴唇皮肉翻卷，碎牙混着鲜血掉落在地。
“呃——”
他口中发出含糊不清的音节，鲜血咳出，刀柄从手中滑落。
在这种恐怖的巨力之下，他初境三层的修为显得脆弱不堪。
一股无法言喻的挫败感从心底浮现。
下一刻，他心脏狂跳，难以置信地瞪大双眼。
陆渊不是凡境二层吗？
怎么会有灵力波动？
他初境了？
灵力化晶！
这得是多么纯粹的灵力！
纵观整个青州镇魔司，恐怕都没有人能做到如此程度！
周通瞳孔震颤不已，眼中满是惊骇。
难怪陆渊有恃无恐！

难怪敢在众目睽睽之下对他出言不逊！
若他早知道陆渊已经从凡境破入初境，又怎么会为林辰出头！
“等——”
他竭力稳住呼吸，试图开口服软，然而断裂的颌骨让他连一个字都说不出来。
“晚了。”
随着一声戏谑，一只皂靴出现在周通视线之中，下一秒就将他的脸踩在地上。
周通浑身一颤，从未受过这般奇耻大辱。
他双拳紧握，几乎要当场爆发。
可浑身浑身经脉就像断了一样疼痛不堪，连动动手指都极为费力。
“入册七年的镇魔卫，就这？哈哈哈哈哈......”
笑声透着肆意与嘲讽。
周通试图挣扎，却见陆渊再度起脚。
周通眼前一黑，彻底没了意识。
“老苏，走了！”
陆渊大袖一甩，转身朝外走去。
“去马场挑两匹好马，抓紧时间早点出发。”
“诶！来了！”
苏定安瞥了一眼地上的周通，快步跟了上去。
在册七年的镇魔卫？
这有什么值得炫耀的吗？

在镇魔司，以下犯上可是大罪，动手之前都不调查清楚吗？
纯纯脑子不好。
......
傍晚，两匹通体黑亮的追风马一前一后，停在了赤霞县镇魔司驻所外。
陆渊和苏定安刚一下马，守门的两名衙役便迎了上来。
“二位便是来自州司的大人吧？”
较为年长的那个衙役上前一步，对苏定安笑着拱手，显然是将他当成了这趟差事的主办。
倒不是苏定安比陆渊年长，而是镇魔司内部有规制。
镇魔卫身穿的锦袍上绣有暗纹，与衙役的制式黑袍高下立判。
陆渊的官服还没赶制出来，穿的是一身便装，自然就被当成了新入门的协办。
苏定安脸色尴尬，陆渊对此倒并不怎么在意。
走入正堂，这里比青州镇魔司要冷清得多，偌大的地方只有两人在场。
不用陆明开口，苏定安便拿着腰牌与卷宗上去说明来意。
之前说好了，他负责带路、指认、摸查具体情况，这点眼力劲还是有的。
书吏收下卷宗，一旁的镇魔卫适时走过来。
“不知这位大人怎么称呼？”
“苏定安，叫我老苏就行。”
那人笑着拱了拱手，“在下吴守信，是赤霞县驻所的镇魔卫，这段时间人手紧缺，几个兄弟都在外办差，就剩我和王书吏看家。”
说罢，吴守信看向站在一旁的陆渊，拱了拱手，算是打过招呼。
得，又一个看走眼的。

苏定安正要开口解释，就听陆渊在一旁开口。
“卷宗我们已经看过了，先说说案情吧，有些细节还想再问问。”
“好，这边坐。”吴守信应了一声，招待二人在一张方桌落座。
苏定安开口问道：“卷宗上说数十名初境武者失踪，具体多少？”
“四十七个。”吴守信一脸凝重道：“都是附近几个小宗门的弟子。”
四十七个人连尸体都没有，若真是被血妖所杀，只怕全都成了血奴。
苏定安点头，继续问道：“陈家又是什么来头？”
吴守信开口解释，“陈家是赤霞县的大户，族中有几人在州城做官，宅子在县城东街，四进的院子约摸五十口人。”
“之前有衙役上报，宅子深夜爆发血光，妖气惊人。”
“可等我们上门探查的时候，陈家周围一切正常，一点异样没有。”
陆渊开口，“进门搜查了吗？”
吴守信摇头，“正常是要进宅子的，可被陈家家主拦了下来，说我们污人清白，要去州司告状。”
“统领大人碍于压力，只能将此事上报州司。”
统领，即属县驻所主官，对于妖魔之事有先斩后奏之权。
若放在一般人家早就破门而入了。
家主敢拦？先拎出来抽两巴掌再说。
可陈家不同，若是破门之后没找到妖魔踪迹，事后肯定免不了被青州官府问责。
所以才将此事搁了下来。
吴守信犹豫片刻，“二位从州司下来，有便宜行事之权，是否现在调集人手前往陈家？”
话音未落，一名衙役跌跌撞撞冲进正堂。

“吴大人，不好了，北渡口妖气乍现，恐有妖魔伤人！”
content_en:
The demon-suppressing guards coming and going stopped one after another, and the whole courtyard fell silent instantly.
Lu Yuan's lips curved into a careless sneer.
So what if I say it again?
This is the first time I heard someone make such a request.
"I said, who are you, but you are worthy of justice! Do you hear me clearly? If not, I will say it again."
"Lu Yuan!"
Zhou Tong shouted loudly, looking like an angry black bear.
He has been a demon-suppressing guard for seven years and has killed hundreds of demons. What newcomer can't politely call him "Master Zhou"?
But this young guy in front of him actually humiliated him in public!
Zhou Tong put one hand on the handle of the knife, his tone filled with coldness.
"I really didn't expect you to be so stupid."
"Do you think you can join the Demon Suppression Division with just a promotion card?"
"To tell you the truth, a newcomer with your qualifications will only be a handyman even if he joins the Demon Suppression Division!"
"But I'm different. I'm a first-level warrior, and I've been a demon-suppressing guard for seven years. Do you think we are more important than you in this demon-suppressing division?"
Zhou Tong looked directly at Lu Yuan with fierce eyes, trying to see a bit of inferiority and confusion on that handsome face.
But no.
Lu Yuan's eyes were calm, and the indifference in his eyes was like an ancient well.
"Three breaths."
He opened his right arm, and his spiritual power exploded like an abyss or sea, instantly turning into a layer of spiritual crystals covering his forearm.
"Just three breaths. After three breaths, you'd better tell me which one is more serious."
He punched out, hitting the opponent's waist and abdomen hard.
Peiran exploded with great power, Zhou Tong's face showed pain, and a mouthful of blood spurted out.
But after all, he was a demon-suppressing guard who had been registered for seven years, and his sophisticated fighting consciousness allowed him to pull out the horizontal sword at his waist immediately.
But he didn't expect that Lu Yuan was faster than him.
Before the Hengdao was unsheathed, the second punch had already been thrown out, hitting him in the face like a cannonball.
Orally, to be precise.
There was only a dull explosion, Zhou Tong's jaw shattered, the flesh of his lips rolled, and his broken teeth fell to the ground mixed with blood.
"Uh-"
He uttered garbled syllables, coughed out blood, and the handle of the knife slipped from his hand.
Under such terrifying power, his cultivation at the third level of the initial realm seemed fragile.
An indescribable feeling of frustration emerged from the bottom of my heart.
The next moment, his heart was beating wildly and his eyes widened in disbelief.
Isn't Lu Yuan on the second level of the mortal realm?
Why are there spiritual fluctuations?
Is he in his first state?
Spiritual power crystallized!
What pure spiritual power this is!
Looking at the entire Qingzhou Demon Suppression Division, I'm afraid no one can do it to this extent!
Zhou Tong's pupils were trembling, and his eyes were full of horror.
No wonder Lu Yuan is confident!
No wonder you dare to speak rudely to him in public!
If he had known that Lu Yuan had broken through from the Mortal Realm to the First Realm, how could he have stood up for Lin Chen!
"Wait-"
He tried to steady his breathing and tried to speak softly, but his broken jaw prevented him from speaking even a single word.
"It's late."
With a joke, a soap boot appeared in Zhou Tong's sight, and in the next second, his face was stamped on the ground.
Zhou Tong trembled all over, he had never suffered such a shame and humiliation.
He clenched his fists and almost exploded on the spot.
But the meridians all over his body were in excruciating pain, as if they were broken, and even moving his fingers was extremely laborious.
"The demon-suppressing guard who has been registered for seven years, is this it? Hahahahaha..."
The laughter was full of wantonness and ridicule.
Zhou Tong tried to struggle, but saw Lu Yuan take off again.
Zhou Tong's vision went dark and he completely lost consciousness.
"Old Su, let's go!"
Lu Yuan flicked his sleeves, turned around and walked out.
"Go to the racecourse and pick out two good horses, and hurry up and start early."
"Hey! Here we come!"
Su Ding'an glanced at Zhou Tong on the ground and followed quickly.
The demon-suppressing guard who has been on the books for seven years?
Is this anything worth showing off?
In the Demon-Suppressing Division, the following crimes are committed:It's a serious crime. Didn't you investigate clearly before taking action?
Pure brain is not good.
...
In the evening, two black horses, one behind the other, stopped outside the Chixia County Demon Division's headquarters.
As soon as Lu Yuan and Su Ding'an got off their horses, two government officials guarding the gate came to greet them.
"Are you two adults from Zhousi?"
The older yamen officer took a step forward, smiled at Su Ding'an and handed him over, obviously regarding him as the host of this errand.
It's not that Su Ding'an is older than Lu Yuan, but that there are internal rules in the Demon Suppression Department.
The brocade robes worn by the demon-suppressing guards were embroidered with dark patterns, which was in stark contrast to the standard black robes worn by the government officials.
Lu Yuan's official uniform hadn't been made yet, so he was wearing casual clothes, so he was naturally regarded as the co-organizer of the new entry.
Su Ding'an looked embarrassed, but Lu Yuan didn't care much about it.
Walking into the main hall, it was much deserted than the Qingzhou Demon Division. There were only two people present in the huge place.
Without Lu Ming having to say anything, Su Ding'an went up with his waist badge and files to explain his purpose.
As agreed before, he was responsible for leading the way, identifying, and checking out the specific situation. He still had a good eye for it.
The scribe accepted the file, and the demon-suppressing guard came over at the right time.
"I wonder what I call this lord?"
"Su Ding'an, just call me Lao Su."
The man smiled and cupped his hands, "I am Wu Shouxin, the demon-suppressing guard stationed in Chixia County. During this time, there is a shortage of manpower. Several brothers are away on business, leaving Secretary Wang and I to look after the house."
After saying that, Wu Shouxin looked at Lu Yuan who was standing aside and cupped his hands as a greeting.
Okay, another one who made a mistake.
Su Ding'an was about to explain when he heard Lu Yuan speak from the side.
"We have already read the file. Let's talk about the case first. There are some details that we still want to ask about."
"Okay, sit here." Wu Shouxin responded and invited the two of them to sit down at a square table.
Su Ding'an asked: "The file says that dozens of first-level warriors are missing, how many specifically?"
"Forty-seven." Wu Shouxin said solemnly: "They are all disciples of several small sects nearby."
Forty-seven people didn't even have corpses. If they were really killed by the blood demon, they would all become blood slaves.
Su Ding'an nodded and continued to ask: "What is the background of the Chen family?"
Wu Shouxin explained, "The Chen family is a large family in Chixia County. Several members of the family are officials in the city. Their house is on the east street of the county seat. There are about fifty people living in the courtyard on the other side."
"Previously, a government official reported that the house erupted in blood late at night, and the evil spirit was astonishing."
"But when we came to investigate, everything around Chen's house was normal, nothing strange at all."
Lu Yuan said, "Have you entered and searched the house?"
Wu Shouxin shook his head, "Normally we would have entered the house, but the head of the Chen family stopped us and said that we were innocent and wanted to file a complaint with the state secretary."
"Due to pressure, the commander had no choice but to report the matter to the state secretary."
The commander, that is, the chief officer in the county, has the power to kill demons first and then report them.
If it were placed in an ordinary house, they would have broken into it long ago.
The head of the family dares to stop him? Take it out first and slap it twice before talking about it.
But the Chen family is different. If no trace of the demon is found after breaking in, they will definitely be held accountable by the Qingzhou government afterwards.
That's why the matter was put aside.
Wu Shouxin hesitated for a moment and said, "You two have come down from the Prefecture Division and have the right to act expediently. Do you want to mobilize people to go to the Chen family now?"
Before he finished speaking, a government servant stumbled into the main hall.
"Mr. Wu, it's not good, evil spirits suddenly appear in Beidukou, there may be demons that may hurt people!"
